/bin/bash -lc 'python -m compileall -q app tests; echo "compileall_exit=$?"; DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///tmp PROCESSOR_KEY= python - <<'"'PY'
try:
    import app.worker
    print('worker_import=ok')
except Exception as exc:
    print(f'worker_import={type(exc).__name__}: {exc}')
PY
printf '%s\\n' '--- git status ---'; git status --short"
